about.title: Quality of graduates comes before numbers.
text: We are in the east end of Houston, and while many schools focus on pushing out as many certified welders as possible, we put the quality of our graduates first.
Our instructors are industry professionals, and you train hands-on in a facility with industry-standard equipment.
We are proficient in welding in confined spaces and difficult access areas, across TIG, MIG and stick.
